arguments.value: This agreement is between R. C. Boyd Enterprises, LLC and Cano Petroleum, Inc. Boyd agrees to produce at least 40 original episodes of Honey Hole per year and to provide Cano with lead sponsor treatment, including a 30-second lead-in promotion at the start of each episode, a 30-second trailer at the end, two 30-second commercials during each episode, signage at public appearances, logo placement on the primary boat and vehicle, and at least two Cano-designated guests on at least six episodes per year. Cano provides approved lead-in, commercial, and trailer materials already produced for use by Boyd. In return, Boyd is to be paid $150,000 in four equal installments of $37,500 on January 1, 2008, April 1, 2008, July 1, 2008, and October 1, 2008. The agreement runs for one year, from January 1, 2008 through December 31, 2008. It is governed by the laws of the State of Texas.
